Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing certain obsolete state retirement system statutes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing certain obsolete state retirementsystem statutes; and repealing RCW 41.32.360 and 41.32.366.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 41.32.360 (Basis of contributions to disability reservefund) and 1991 c 35 s 47, 1963 ex.s. c 14 s 8, 1955 c 274 s 17, & 1947c 80 s 36; and RCW 41.32.366 (Basis of contributions to death benefit fund)and 1991 c 35 s 48 & 1963 ex.s. c 14 s 10.
